statement: Reconstruct the scoped Coursera public catalog and a deterministic offline learner journey: browse 11 subjects, search and filter 40 seeded records, inspect the Deep Learning Specialization and component courses, preview local materials, use site-isolated local accounts, and reach a clone-local enrollment review whose payment behavior is restricted to local-sandbox. Authenticated source behavior was unavailable and is represented only by explicitly labeled deterministic offline simulation.

actor_scope.notes: Anonymous home, browse, subject, search shell, specialization, component-course, login, signup, contact, and not-found surfaces were observed.
No authenticated browser context was supplied; dashboard, lesson, quiz, progress, history, and preferences use deterministic synthetic offline state.
Public login/signup shells were observed; clone mutations use only the generated WebsiteBench auth/backend runtime.

simulations: sim.catalog: 34 additional records are deterministic truthful simulations; the Deep Learning series uses direct, structural, or inferred evidence classifications per record.
sim.authenticated-learning: account, dashboard, lesson, quiz, progress, certificate, preferences, and history states are clone-local because authenticated source evidence is unavailable.
sim.local-payment: checkout accepts only generated runtime local-sandbox scenarios; no card, bank, wallet, provider credential, live key, or remote payment call is accepted.
sim.local-mail: registration and password-reset messages remain in the generated site-bound local outbox.
out_of_scope: Authenticated source exploration until a human supplies a usable logged-in browser context.
Source account creation, sign-in submission, recovery submission, enrollment, payment, lesson completion, quiz submission, review publication, preference mutation, or production cancellation.
Credentials, cookies, tokens, real personal data, real email delivery, card or bank data, Stripe, live payment, and any remote runtime request.
External help origins, analytics, advertising, identity-provider login, third-party embeds, and catalog content beyond the frozen 40-record seed.
Harbor authoring, public deployment, publication, and any rights or redistribution determination.

release_authority.note: Diagnostics and this frozen scope are diagnostic-only and convey no merge, deployment, publication, legal, or redistribution authorization.
